column8: Rust covers ordered partial merge for serialized numeric/textual/JSON/date/duration-shaped entries; Go typed value conversion and BinaryJSON byte equality remain external.
Rust covers empty-to-NULL output, scalar/null ordering, string escaping, and nested JSON fragments; Go expression evaluation and full aggregate execution remain external.
Rust covers source partial-state and empty-slice allocation shape plus reset retention; Go per-value memory delta accounting remains external.
The source spill round-trip obligation remains explicit at this boundary; Rust covers the underlying ordered entry state while chunk serialization/deserialization and spill helpers remain external.
